landing.heroSubtitle: bKash-verified. Run by alumni. Every taka reviewed.
landing.howStep1Body: Pick a preset or type your own amount.
landing.howStep2Body: Send to our bKash merchant number. Keep the TrxID.
landing.howStep3Body: An admin verifies the TrxID and confirms the donation.
landing.peopleSectionLead: The names on every receipt. Three alumni, publicly accountable for every taka that moves through the foundation.
landing.trustBody: Every transaction is reviewed individually. Each donation carries a TrxID and is personally approved by an admin on our team. No money leaves the organisation without a verified approval.
landing.ctaStripHeadline: Send what you can. We'll handle the rest.
landing.ctaStripSubtitle: Three minutes is all it takes.
landing.eventsSectionLead: Upcoming meetings, drives, and fundraisers. Join when the date is confirmed.
landing.storiesBody: Each transaction carries a story — an operation, a schoolbook, relief in a flood. Last year your giving reached 127 families. Every donation was individually verified and every taka spent is archived.
landing.storyFact3: 100% of spend receipts kept on archive
landing.faqSectionLead: Answers to the questions we hear most.
landing.faq1A: There is no government tax deduction for charitable giving in Bangladesh. We keep receipts for every transaction and can provide them on request.
landing.faq2A: Yes — you may donate anonymously. That said, we encourage public donations for the sake of transparency; it builds trust with other donors.
landing.faq3Q: Can I choose what cause my donation supports?
landing.faq3A: Yes. On the donate page you can pick one of four causes: general fund, education, medical, or emergency.
landing.faq4Q: How long does TrxID verification take?
landing.faq4A: Usually under four hours. In some cases it can take up to 24 hours, especially on holidays.
